evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain yyyy-MM-dd calendar date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-03-01"} returned 200 and set the date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and cleared it to null. PATCH /todos/3 with only a title change left dueDate unchanged.

evidence.AC5: The home page listed each due date next to its title, e.g. (2026-10-14), (2026-10-15), (2026-10-16) and (2026-01-01). The todo with no due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: On the home page only the todo due 2026-10-14 showed the text "überfällig". The due-today, future, no-date and done-past todos did not.
